snippet.title: Kya Sadqah Se Paisa Kam Hota Hai? | Muslim 2588 | Allah Ka Hisaab #shorts
snippet.description:
Sadqah maal mein kami nahin karta. Jo maaf kar de, Allah us ki izzat barha deta hai. Aur jo Allah ke liye aajizi kare, Allah use buland kar deta hai.

Rasool Allah (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam) ne farmaya (Abu Hurairah Radi Allahu Anhu se riwayat):
«مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلَّا عِزًّا، وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ»

References
• Sahih Muslim 2588: https://sunnah.com/muslim:2588
• Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2029 (Sahih): https://sunnah.com/tirmidhi:2029

Aaj ek chhota sa sadqah dein, chahe ek rupaya hi kyun na ho. Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
